overview_description.description: Vantage is a cloud cost management platform for modern enterprise engineering teams. It helps teams analyze, allocate, and optimize cloud spend across major cloud providers, infrastructure, AI services, SaaS tools, and supports custom costs via FOCUS-compatible cost uploads. Vantage provides granular cost attribution, unit cost analysis, and AI-driven capabilities, including automated agents and MCP-based integrations, to support engineering, finance, and FinOps teams in making timely, data-driven decisions. Vantage also offers robust programmatic orchestration via API and Terraform provider for automation purposes.

about_short_description.short_description: Vantage is a cloud cost management platform that helps teams analyze, allocate, and optimize cloud spend across cloud, AI, and SaaS.

product.name: Vantage FinOps Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for analyzing, allocating, reporting on, and optimizing cloud, SaaS, and AI spending across providers such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

product.name: Vantage FinOps Agent
product.description: An AI-assisted FinOps service that answers questions about cost and usage data, investigates anomalies, evaluates recommendations, and supports cost-management workflows through natural language.

product.name: Vantage Autopilot
product.description: An automated AWS commitment-optimization service that analyzes usage, recommends Savings Plans and Database Savings Plans, and can purchase eligible commitments on a customer’s behalf.

product.name: Vantage K8s Agent
product.description: A Kubernetes cost-visibility and efficiency service that attributes compute costs to namespaces and labels, identifies idle or wasted capacity, and provides rightsizing recommendations.

product.name: Vantage MSP FinOps Software
product.description: A multi-client FinOps solution for managed service providers that centralizes cloud cost monitoring, automated reporting, client invoicing, alerts, and cost optimization across customer environments.
